log_level.label: Log level
log_level.help: Set the log level and include severity in supported SGLang launch logs.

max_model_len.label: Maximum Context Length
max_model_len.help: Leave empty to use the model configuration

quantization.label: Quantization Method
quantization.help: The quantization format is determined jointly by the model and image

trust_remote_code.label: Trust Remote Code
trust_remote_code.help: Allow custom code from the model repository to be loaded

enable_auto_tool_choice.label: Automatic Tool Selection
enable_auto_tool_choice.help: Allow the model to select tools automatically for each request

allowed_local_media_path.label: Allowed Local Media Path
allowed_local_media_path.help: An absolute, non-root path inside the container

gpu_memory_utilization.label: GPU Memory Utilization
gpu_memory_utilization.help: Per-GPU memory limit for this instance; divide capacity manually when multiple instances share a GPU

enable_chunked_prefill.label: Chunked Prefill
enable_chunked_prefill.help: When disabled, the maximum batched token count cannot be smaller than the context length

max_num_batched_tokens.label: Maximum Batched Tokens
max_num_batched_tokens.help: Leave empty to derive the value from the GPU model and performance profile

max_num_seqs.label: Maximum Concurrent Sequences
max_num_seqs.help: Leave empty to derive the value from available GPU memory

enable_cache_report.label: Cache Hit Stats
enable_cache_report.help: Include prefix-cache hit token counts in each response's usage

enable_request_metrics.label: Per-request Timings
enable_request_metrics.help: The last event of each response also carries the request's queue, prefill and decode times, which the monitor's request view shows. Takes effect on images known to run vLLM 0.25.0 or later; other images start without it.

kv_cache_dtype.label: KV Cache Precision
kv_cache_dtype.help: FP8 can significantly increase KV capacity, but requires support from the model and engine version

kv_offloading_size.label: KV Offload to Memory
kv_offloading_size.help: Total memory-tier capacity across all GPUs in GiB, not capacity per GPU

kv_disk_offload.label: KV Offload to Disk
kv_disk_offload.help: The disk tier is relayed through the memory tier, so configure the memory tier first

shared_kv_dir.label: Shared KV Directory
shared_kv_dir.help: The platform creates and mounts a managed host directory at this container path, and keeps it inside the disk tier capacity.

kv_disk_limit_gib.label: Disk Tier Capacity (GiB)
kv_disk_limit_gib.help: Ceiling the platform enforces on the disk tier directory; the engine has no such limit. Leave empty to let the platform derive it from the model weights.

enforce_eager.label: Enforce Eager Mode
enforce_eager.help: Starts faster and uses less GPU memory, but reduces steady-state decoding performance

speculative_algorithm.label: Speculative Decoding Algorithm
speculative_algorithm.help: For vLLM the list is only suggestions: type any method name the engine supports and it is passed as written; whether the chosen image supports it is yours to check. For SGLang, choose from the list. For an algorithm that needs a draft, such as DFlash, mount a registered model under Extra Mounts and enter its container path as the draft model.

speculative_draft_model.label: Draft Model
speculative_draft_model.placeholder: Container path, such as /draft for a model mounted under Extra Mounts; or a model ID

kv_cache_memory_bytes.label: KV Cache GPU Memory in Bytes

cpu_offload_gb.label: CPU Weight Offload (GiB)
cpu_offload_gb.help: This offloads model weights and is unrelated to KV Offload

enable_metrics.label: Enable Inference Metrics
enable_metrics.help: Expose engine inference metrics for GPUWorks monitoring
